Thanks again for your time today, Cathy and team — really helpful conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth.

Summary of pain & goals (what you told us)
- Need demonstrable proof points for SOC 2 readiness (Type II gap coverage and timeline).
- Audit log retention and searchable export for 1–3 years (regulatory requirement for certain merchants).
- DPA and data residency language alignment (EU customers next quarter).
- Confirmation of what pen test artifacts you require (reports, remediation timelines, vulnerability triage logs).

What I’ll deliver by EOD Monday:
- Redwood SOC 2 one-pager that maps our control families to common CobaltPay asks (attachment: redwood_soc2-summary.pdf).
- A proposed artifact matrix showing where each evidence item lives and how to extract it (sheet: pen-test-evidence-checklist.xlsx).
- DPA template (with our standard clauses) for your legal review (dpa_template_CobaltPay.docx).

Please confirm these priorities are accurate and add any missing artifacts we should include. Also confirm who on your side should receive the artifact drop (individuals or a shared mailbox).

Suggested next steps / timeline
1) You confirm evidence recipients and any additional items by Mon 12/14.
2) We drop artifacts to the shared Drive link and notify your secops.
3) If helpful, schedule a 45-minute evidence walkthrough with our infra team (we suggest Tue/Wed next week).

Attachments: redwood_soc2-summary.pdf, dpa_template_CobaltPay.docx, pen-test-evidence-checklist.xlsx

Best,
